name: Drag Float 3D Gallery
description: Full-screen gallery where images float at random depths in a pseudo 3D space and can be dragged to rotate the whole scene, with inertia and perspective scaling.
contents: Images scattered at seeded random positions and depths inside a full-screen stage
behavior: Drag with mouse or touch rotates the scene around both axes
Momentum continues after release and decays smoothly
Images scale and stack by perspective depth and hide when behind the camera
editableByProps: Image list, background color, image size, corner radius
Depth range, perspective, drag feel and inertia, random layout seed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how images are positioned in space
Change the projection or rotation math

fixed: Stage is full-bleed and 100vh tall, sized from the window
Drag is captured on the stage with touch scrolling disabled, so vertical page scroll over it is blocked on touch
